facts.material: polycarbonate enclosure with lithium-polymer battery and electronics
facts.function: worn over an implanted glucose sensor; powers it and wirelessly transmits glucose data to a mobile app
facts.form: reusable transmitter imported separately from sensors, in trays of 20
facts.end_use: part of Eversense365 continuous glucose monitoring system for diabetics

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 9027 instruments for physical or chemical analysis; chapter 90 and section XVI/XVII notes checked; transmitter cannot function alone and is a part of the CGM instrument

rejected_alternatives.reason: electro-diagnostic apparatus; CBP treats CGM as 9027 measuring instrument
wireless transmission is ancillary to the CGM system
alarm indicator panels; N360490 concerns a secondary alarm, different good
N355538 is a complete optical CGM, not a transmitter part

classification.rationale: N354553 held a CGM sensor, a part of the CGM system, in 9027.90.5695; the transmitter is likewise a reusable part of the system, so 9027.90.56.95.
